approvalStatus: UNAPPROVED SEED. Not clinically validated. Requires sign-off by the Head of Laboratory Medicine and the relevant clinical directorates before it may classify a real result.
rationale: The critical-result control cannot classify anything without thresholds, and thresholds are site-owned: they vary with assay, analyser, population and local policy. This file exists so the mechanism is testable and so a laboratory has something concrete to correct. Values below are widely cited adult critical-action limits, deliberately conservative, and every one needs local verification against the site's own assay and reference ranges.
notes: Adult values only. Neonatal and paediatric critical limits differ substantially and are NOT modelled here; a paediatric result classified against these thresholds would be wrong.
Thresholds are absolute action limits, not reference ranges. A result inside the reference range is normal; a result beyond a critical limit demands action within minutes.
Delta checks, trend-based criticality and specimen-quality rejection are not modelled.
Units are stated per analyte and MUST match the incoming result; the classifier refuses to compare across units rather than converting.

qualitativeCritical.note: A positive blood culture is a critical result regardless of organism.
Organisms in CSF demand immediate action.

escalation.note: Tiers are elapsed minutes from the moment the loop opened, not from dispatch, because a dispatch that never happened must still escalate.
